meta.title: Flowboard | Productivity that keeps the whole team in step
meta.description: Flowboard puts tasks, projects, and plans in one board, so every person sees what is next and who owns it.

hero.title: One board where the whole team sees what is next
hero.subtitle: Flowboard turns scattered tasks into a shared plan: projects, deadlines, and owners in one place, updated as work moves.
hero.proof: Sample project board with demo tasks
hero.mockCaption: Demo data. Tasks shown are samples.

problem.title: Work lives in five places. Nobody knows what is next
problem.text: Tasks hide in chat, email, and notebooks. Deadlines slip because the plan lives in one person's head, and the team asks the same status questions every week.

benefits.title: A plan the team can actually follow
benefits.subtitle: Four things Flowboard does for a busy team.

items.title: Tasks with a clear owner
items.text: Every task has one owner and one due date, so nothing waits for someone who thought someone else had it.

items.title: Projects on one board
items.text: Columns show what is planned, in progress, and done, so the state of a project is visible at a glance.

items.title: Plans that fit the week
items.text: A weekly view puts deadlines, meetings, and focus time side by side, so the week is planned before it starts.

items.title: Work together without the meeting
items.text: Comments, files, and updates live on the task itself, so the discussion stays with the work.

tagline: Stop asking what is next. Open the board and the week is already there.

steps.title: How Flowboard works
steps.subtitle: Three steps from scattered tasks to one plan.

items.title: Add your projects
items.text: Create a board for each project and add the tasks that are already on your list.

items.title: Give each task an owner
items.text: Assign a person and a due date. Flowboard reminds the owner before the date arrives.

items.title: Move work across the board
items.text: Drag a task from planned to done. The board, the plan, and the team view update together.

items.quote: Our Monday status meeting went from an hour to fifteen minutes. The board already says what is done and what is stuck.
items.name: Rania Samy

items.quote: I finally see my week in one place. Tasks, deadlines, and the plan for Friday are all on the same board.
items.name: Mostafa Zaki

items.q: Can I use Flowboard on my own?
items.a: Yes. The Starter plan works for one person, and you can invite the team later without moving anything.
Each project gets a board with columns, such as planned, in progress, and done. Move a task across the board as work moves.
The web app needs a connection to sync. Changes made offline on the mobile app sync when you reconnect.

items.q: Can I import tasks from another tool?
items.a: Yes. Import a spreadsheet or a file from common task tools. The import guide is in the help center.
Yes. Flowboard is fully bilingual, with Arabic right to left layout and English left to right.
Only the people you invite to the project. Private boards stay visible to their members alone.
Yes. The trial includes Starter features and needs no credit card.
Yes. Cancel from account settings. Your boards stay available until the end of the paid period, and you can export them first.

final.title: Put the week on one board
final.text: Start a free trial and move your first project into Flowboard today.
final.note: No credit card needed. Cancel anytime.
